M6 WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT BUY
IT IS A REACHABILITY RESULT, NOT A MEASUREMENT. Nothing here was fitted to a
trajectory and no new data was read; the chain is arithmetic and the inputs are
loop 142's two rates and loop 148's three receptor ratios.
What it converts: loop 148's 'a 1.5x receptor change cannot make a 20.3x rate
change' becomes 'it makes it if and only if the chain is at least n long and the
resting state is DUB-dominated'. That is a statement with numbers in it and it can
be refuted by measuring chain length or a DUB/E3 rate ratio.
IT IDENTIFIES NO PROTEIN AND NO TIMING. Nine mechanisms have been eliminated on
that question -- transcription, two TF networks, degron motifs, 5'UTR control,
relocalisation, ubiquitin annotation, protease competition, and phosphodegrons
twice -- and a Markov chain on chain length does not touch any of it.
